meta.description: Clinical reference and decision-support workspace for urologists and andrologists.

search.placeholder: Search topics, lab tests, tools, guidelines…
search.hint: Type to search modules, topics, lab parameters, tools, forms, algorithms, guidelines and cases.
search.scopeNote: Search runs in your browser. Nothing you type is stored or sent anywhere.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeText: Structured clinical reference for urology and andrology. Open a module, search a topic, or continue where you left off.
dashboard.recentEmpty: Pages you open will appear here.
dashboard.bookmarksEmpty: Bookmark any page to keep it here.
dashboard.contentStatusText: Clinical content is being written and medically reviewed separately. Sections show their review status until approved content is published.
dashboard.frequentToolsEmpty: Tools you use most will appear here.
dashboard.guidelineUpdatesEmpty: No guideline updates have been recorded yet.

modules.title: Clinical modules
modules.intro: Five independent modules with a consistent structure.

male-infertility.title: Male Infertility
male-infertility.description: History, examination, semen analysis, hormonal and genetic evaluation, diagnostic pathway and treatment.

erectile-dysfunction.title: Erectile Dysfunction
erectile-dysfunction.description: Classification, anamnesis, cardiovascular risk, laboratory work-up, IIEF-5 and treatment options.

premature-ejaculation.title: Premature Ejaculation
premature-ejaculation.description: Lifelong and acquired forms, diagnostic criteria, IELT, PEDT and evidence-based treatment.

hypogonadism.title: Male Hypogonadism
hypogonadism.description: Primary and secondary forms, hormonal diagnostics, treatment decisions and fertility implications.

clinical-assessment.title: Clinical Assessment
clinical-assessment.description: Integrated workflow: initial assessment, examination, test selection, decision trees and referral.

status.pendingReviewText: This section has no approved content yet. It will be published after review by a qualified physician, with sources and version.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageText: Clinical content is published separately for each language after verified translation.
settings.dataText: Only bookmarks, recently opened modules and the sidebar state are stored in this browser. No patient data is stored.

disclaimer.short: For qualified healthcare professionals. Educational and reference use only; not a substitute for clinical judgement. No diagnosis or prescribing is made by this platform.

content.translationBehind: This translation is behind the original version. Check the original for recent changes.
content.draftBanner: Draft preview: not medically reviewed. Visible only in preview builds.
content.requiresReviewBanner: Parts of this content could not be verified and require review.
content.otherLanguages: Not yet available in this language. Verified versions exist in:
content.parametersNote: Reference limits, units and the WHO edition are shown here once a reviewed dataset is published.
content.rangeNotApproved: This reference dataset is not approved yet.
content.statusIntro: Review state of every section and topic, by language. Only approved content is shown without a warning.
content.statusSummary: {done} of {total} items approved in this language
content.safetyRuleTestosterone: Testosterone replacement is never presented on this platform as routine treatment for men who are actively seeking fertility.
content.relatedModulesText: Clinical assessment brings together the history, examination and test selection from these modules.

tools.title: Clinical tools
tools.intro: Calculators and interpreters for everyday use. Every result supports clinical assessment and is never a diagnosis.
tools.notDiagnosis: This result is not a diagnosis. Interpret it together with the history, examination and other findings.
tools.questionnaireMissing: The validated questionnaire text and its scoring bands have not been added yet. The tool works here once the licensed file is added to the content library.
tools.questionnaireHow: The score is the sum of the scores of the selected answers. An interpretation band is shown only when every item is answered.
tools.incomplete: Answer every item to see the interpretation.
tools.limitationsGeneric: A score supports clinical assessment and is not a diagnosis. Interpret it together with the history, examination and other findings.
tools.weightRange: Enter a weight between 20 and 400 kg.
tools.heightRange: Enter a height between 100 and 250 cm.
tools.bmiHow: BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)², rounded to one decimal.
tools.bmiNoBands: Weight categories appear once a reviewed source for them is added to the content library.
tools.semenEnter: Enter values from the laboratory report. Leave blank anything that was not measured.
tools.noDataset: No semen reference dataset has been published yet.
tools.semenHow: Each value is compared with the lower or upper reference limit in the selected dataset. Total sperm number is calculated as concentration × volume when it is not entered.
tools.semenLimitations: Semen parameters alone cannot establish fertility or infertility. The reference limits are lower 5th-percentile values from men whose partners conceived, not diagnostic thresholds.
tools.summaryNone: No entered value is outside the reference limits.
tools.hormoneIntro: Enter each result together with the reference range printed on the same laboratory report. Ranges differ between laboratories and assays, so this tool does not use fixed limits.
tools.hormoneHow: Each value is compared with the laboratory's own reference range from the same report.
tools.hormoneLimitations: Hormone results depend on sampling conditions, the assay and the clinical context. Distinguishing primary from secondary hypogonadism requires clinical review.
tools.rangeInvalid: The lower end of the range must be below the upper end.
tools.pathwayIntro: Step-by-step diagnostic pathway for suspected male hypogonadism. Each step links to its explanation and sources once reviewed.
tools.libraryIntro: All published reference datasets, each tied to one source and edition.
tools.libraryEmpty: No reference datasets have been published yet.

iief-5.title: IIEF-5 / SHIM
iief-5.description: Five-item erectile function questionnaire with score interpretation.

bmi.title: BMI calculator
bmi.description: Body-mass index from weight and height.

semen-analysis.title: Semen analysis interpreter
semen-analysis.description: Compare semen parameters with a selected WHO edition dataset.

hormonal-assessment.title: Hormonal assessment
hormonal-assessment.description: Compare hormone results with the laboratory's own reference ranges.

reference-ranges.title: Clinical reference range library
reference-ranges.description: Reference datasets by source and edition.

algorithms.title: Diagnostic algorithms
algorithms.intro: Clinical pathways as step-by-step flowcharts, with requirement levels, referral points and sources.
algorithms.basisSpec: Step structure from the project specification. Explanations, decision criteria and sources are pending medical review.

assessment.title: Anamnesis forms
assessment.intro: Structured history templates. Required fields are checked, follow-up questions appear when relevant, and a printable summary is generated.
assessment.privacy: Do not enter names, dates of birth, ID numbers or other identifying details. Answers stay only in this browser tab and are lost when it is closed or reloaded.

fields.urologicalHistory: Previous urological conditions, infections or procedures
fields.previousConception: Any previous conception with any partner?
fields.testosteroneUse: Testosterone or anabolic steroid use, current or past?
fields.otherLifestyle: Other lifestyle factors (activity, diet, occupational exposures)

assessment.errorsSummary: Please correct {n} field(s) before generating the summary.
assessment.freeTextHint: No names or other identifying details.
assessment.summaryNote: Generated from the answers in this form. Review before use; it is not stored anywhere.

guidelines.title: Guidelines library
guidelines.intro: Every source cited in the platform, grouped by organisation, with its verification status, update history and the pages that use it.
guidelines.verificationNote: A source counts as verified only after a reviewer has checked the edition, chapter and link against the original publication and recorded the date. Unverified sources must not be relied on for clinical decisions.
guidelines.empty: No sources have been added yet.
guidelines.editionPending: Edition year to be confirmed at verification
guidelines.unverifiedDetail: This source has not been verified yet. Its edition, chapter and link must be checked against the original publication before content citing it can be approved.
guidelines.noUpdatesDetail: No updates have been recorded for this source.
guidelines.notUsed: No published page cites this source yet.

cases.title: Clinical cases
cases.policy: Every case is fictional or fully anonymised, and is written or reviewed by a physician. Cases are for education only and are not guidance for an individual patient.
cases.emptyText: Cases appear here once a physician has written or reviewed them. Each case includes a presentation, workup and self-assessment questions.
cases.educationalNote: Educational case. Fictional or fully anonymised; not guidance for an individual patient.
cases.discussionDeferred: Case discussions need accounts and moderation, and will be added together with the backend.
